title: Mixed Event — A Bright Future!! — Episode1 Lyrics That Suit This Song

meta.Episode: Episode1 — Lyrics That Suit This Song
meta.Event Outline: Bit by bit, the members of Leo/need continue preparations for their first show together. Their new song is coming along well, and all that's left is for Ichika to add her lyrics. She's determined to express the feelings that Saki put into the composition, but will it be so easy...?

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I think we're set with this song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay!
Finally, we played it without missing a note!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great work, girls.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's like the pieces for this song just started falling into place once we worked out each individual part.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can't wait to see you all perform.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can't wait to play it either!
The very first, completely original Leo/need song♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel the same way...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Our very first original song.
It carries so much more weight when you put it that way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, Shiho, thank you both.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki's the one who actually wrote it. I didn't do anything by comparison.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's not true at all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure, Saki came up with the overarching melody, but we wouldn't have known how to put the rest together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exactly. We would've kept wandering in the dark if it weren't for you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, Shiho, thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll start practicing this song in full tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In the meantime, we'll throw in some placeholder lyrics while Ichika works on the actual words. Then, we'll need to see how her lyrics fit into the song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Grrr...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sort of...
Is he really just gonna keep hiding like this...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Don't mind her.
It's just something we're dealing with right now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, I can't wait to see what you've come up with, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm so excited to see what kind of lyrics you wrote♪
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A slight tone of uncertainty or a sense of doubt might make it sound better during the chorus...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A song that's just for us...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I do think that it'd be really great to make music that touches people's hearts like Shiho says...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I realized something while I was writing this song!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It finally hit me that it's probably gonna be more challenging that we could ever imagine!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Especially considering how difficult it is to compose music from scratch.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, I warned all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, but...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But then I realized something else!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As hard as it was to write this song, we might have to make even tougher decisions along the way while we try to go pro!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I wanted to come up with something that could help cheer us up if we do start having a tough time and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's what I want this song to convey...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Saki...!
It really is a wonderful song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
I'm so glad that we managed to finish it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(That's the message Saki wants to send...
My lyrics need to reflect that as well.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How lost I may be doesn't matter, I know everything will be...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
N-No, that's a little too direct.
That's more like how I feel instead of what Saki wants to convey...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something more roundabout might actually be better in this case...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I could throw in that here...
Oh, and this rhymes perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This might actually sound really cool when we put it all together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, good morning!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wah! S-Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? Whatcha writing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, just some lyrics.
But they're still a work in progress...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, you are?!
Lemme see♪
se_event_future_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Wait, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Lost. So lost in total sadness,
but being with you is true happiness...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, Ichi, this is so you!
I love it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: B-But it's still a work in progress!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, this is awesome♪
I wanna keep reading!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You two seem awfully excited this morning. Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, good morning!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki won't give me back my notebook...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your notebook?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Ichi was writing lyrics just now for this song I wrote!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Tenma, you can write your own music...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, my band, Leo/need, you know♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's incredible. And you're writing the lyrics, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes. They're still a work in progress so I'm not really ready to show them to anyone yet, but Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I really wanted to see what you came up with♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I fully understand how you feel right now, Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When it comes to singing and dancing, I'd rather have people see the finished product as opposed to something that I'm still practicing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? You go through that too, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Well, that's just me. I know some who have no problem showing others their own processes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But Hoshino's trying to reach a certain level of completeness, right? So it may be best to give her a little more time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you mind giving back her notebook, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I-Ichi, I'm so sorry!
I'll be looking forward to seeing what you come up with!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, both of you. I promise to write something that'll do your song justice.
